name: Samvardhana Motherson
title: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has submitted with the Stock Exchange a disclosure on Corporate Presentation.

read.thesis: Record H1FY27 revenue of Rs 73,524 cr (+22%) and Q2 normalised PAT +37%, but capex guidance held at Rs 6,000 cr ±10% with Rs 1,971 cr spent in Q2 and leverage steady at 0.8x.

capex.quote: Capex guidance for FY27 is Rs. 6,000 Cr (+/-10%)

triggers.label: Booked business USD 106 bn all-time high
triggers.quote: Strong Booked Business of USD 106 billion* All-time high

triggers.label: MPP margin hit by input costs
triggers.quote: MPP margin improvement through cost optimization, offset rising input costs and acquired assets integration impacts

triggers.label: Q2 capex Rs 1,971 cr, 59% of EBITDA
triggers.quote: Capex of Rs. 1,971 Crores (59% of EBITDA)

guidance.quote: Capex guidance for FY27 is Rs. 6,000 Cr (+/-10%)

prior_guidance_check.quote: Capex in-line with growth priorities and yearly guidance

red_flags.label: Copper and crude cost pressure
red_flags.quote: Copper pricescontinued to rise, increasing6% QoQ, continuing commodity cost pressures

growth.why: Management held FY27 capex guidance at Rs 6,000 Cr (+/-10%) and reported Q2 capex of Rs 1,971 Cr, with booked business at a USD 106 bn all-time high as the main demand backing; no revenue growth % or specific capacity additions were given in the brief.
